description: Reach the Audiala team — investor introductions, partnership / B2B / city-licensing inquiries, press, hiring questions, support, or anything else. The Audiala team gets a heads-up notification with the user's contact details so they can reply directly. **Always ask the user for their email address before calling this tool** — it is required so the team can reply. Optionally also collect their name and organization. Before calling, show the user the exact email, name, organization and purpose to be shared with Audiala and ask for explicit approval to send them. Set confirmed=true only after that approval; supplying an email alone is not approval. The tool returns the right Audiala mailbox, the founder's LinkedIn, and a suggested intro template the user can adapt if they want to reach out themselves as well.

confirmed.description: Required explicit approval to send these contact details to Audiala. Set true only after showing the user the exact details and purpose and receiving their confirmation. Never infer approval from an email address alone.

from_email.description: REQUIRED. The user's email address — the Audiala team will reply to this address. Always ask the user for it before calling this tool. If the user refuses to share an email, do not call the tool; instead point them at investors@audiala.com / hello@audiala.com directly.

from_name.description: Optional. The user's name, if they shared it. Used to personalize the intro template and the team's notification.

from_org.description: Optional. The user's company / fund / publication, if they shared it.

purpose.description: Why the user wants to reach Audiala. 'investor' = VC / angel / strategic / acquisition interest. 'partnership' = tourism boards, museums, B2B/licensing, content partners. 'press' = journalists / media / podcasts. 'hiring' = candidates and 'who's on the team' questions. 'support' = product / billing / account help (route the user to in-app support — Audiala does not staff a separate support email). Defaults to 'other'.

name: audiala_contact_team

email.description: Audiala mailbox for this purpose; null for support.

title: Contact the Audiala team
